notes: The first paragraph gives the author's elimination of g=0 with nu at most 2: he uses the written genus decomposition, concludes that all vertex genera and h_1 vanish, calls the graph a tree with at least two ends, and obtains the displayed-in-prose lower bound nu at least 2+2=4. This records the argument on the page; no independent mathematical verification was performed.

The next paragraph defines a curve of type G and a G-épinglage by an isomorphism of its maquette with G. The revisions replace MD-graphe by maquette and recast the curve terminology. The final paragraph applies type G to geometric fibers of a relative curve and breaks off after des.
All mathematical relations in this sheet stand within manuscript prose rows. H's use of display environments is a wrapper/layout choice and does not create a collation row.
The single poids/points cluster is heavily reworked; the final does not invent H's separate canceled span before les or a complete extra canceled poids. The middle-letter doubt remains.

The two MD prefixes are visibly interlinear additions that were subsequently struck. Their terminal hyphens are retained only as doubtful because they merge with the crossing strokes. The later standart is inserted above the canceled adjective after courbe; C remains visible at the end of that line.

The C/X after sur contains both a thin curve and two heavy diagonals. X is preferred because its diagonals dominate the extant ink, but no writing order or deletion chronology is asserted. H's X remains an admissible reading, so no settled misreading by H is asserted for this still-undecided mark.

The additional bar beneath I is separate from its ordinary lower serif. The ornate base S is kept as mathcal S. The first and last terms of every mathematical relation, all subscripts, inequalities and handwritten numerals were checked visually.
The light bottom-left 16 is transcribed using the common mspage footer encoding, with unidentified hand recorded in inventory. No dark author page number is present at the head.

The 25-line count comprises nineteen body rows, five distinct interlinear levels and one footer number. The first maquette and first MD prefix occupy separate interlinear heights; the second MD and live standart share an interlinear level. The other two insertion levels are G- and final maquettes.

The final maquettes is live. The curved ink below part of that insertion continues the descender of géom. from the preceding body line and is not treated as a separate underline. Both the crossed types/des phrase and the following live des are preserved.
